title: Census deterministic 2: fewer sources need reading
goal: A census decides by tool the source kinds the 2026-09-26 census sent to reading although nothing had changed: pinned files whose cited passages are word for word at the newer commit or release are re-pinned and re-pointed with no model; unpinned live pages without a page date are decided by a detection baseline that phase 3 records for every confirmed source; github.com issue, wiki and repository pages get a provider signal; Learn pages that map to a public MicrosoftDocs repository are detected by its git history instead of one HTTP request each; a name-resolution error is retried once and counted apart; and more facts carry a located anchor, at no loss of anchor precision.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
